title: The 5 Fastest Land Speed Records Ever, Ranked (#1 Broke the Sound Barrier)

scenes.text: Only one car in history has broken the sound barrier. It's number one.

scenes.label: Green Monster · 576 mph
scenes.text: Number five: the Green Monster. About five hundred seventy-six miles an hour in nineteen sixty-five, powered by a fighter jet engine.

scenes.label: Spirit of America · 600 mph
scenes.text: Number four: Spirit of America. About six hundred miles an hour. Craig Breedlove took the record back just eight days later.

scenes.label: Blue Flame · 622 mph
scenes.text: Number three: Blue Flame, a rocket-powered car. About six hundred twenty-two miles an hour in nineteen seventy.

scenes.label: Thrust2 · 633 mph
scenes.text: Number two: Thrust2. About six hundred thirty-three miles an hour in nineteen eighty-three, driven by Richard Noble.

scenes.label: ThrustSSC · 763 mph
scenes.text: Number one: ThrustSSC. Seven hundred sixty-three miles an hour in nineteen ninety-seven. Faster than sound, on the ground.

description:
The five fastest official land speed records ever set.
Number one, ThrustSSC, drove faster than the speed of sound across the Nevada desert in 1997.
Would you ever drive a car that fast?
first_comment: Which record would you want to drive? And what should we rank next?
